title: How AI is changing the way product teams work
summary: Explore how AI is reshaping product, data, and engineering roles with expert insights at MXP Sydney on November 12, 2026.
body_markdown:
Hello Everyone


👋


AI is changing how teams work. But what does that actually mean for product teams? We’re bringing together three leaders from across the ANZ tech and product community at MXP Sydney to dig into this.


🎤


Alexis Soulopoulos — CEO, EverAI


🎤


Tristan Nicholas — SPM, Domain


🎤


Jonny Wermut — SPM, Woolies X They’ll get into the questions many teams are figuring out right now: → How are product, data and engineering roles changing? → What skills matter most in an AI-first world? → What gets easier with AI — and what still needs human judgement? → And how should teams rethink the way they work together? Expect a real conversation, not an AI hype session — with perspectives from people navigating these changes firsthand.


📅


12 November 2026


📍


Sydney If you’re joining us, we’d love to hear what questions you’re wrestling with too.
